places.en: Atmospheric Man Mo Temple stands at the corner of Ladder Street. Inside its red-and-gold interior, smoke curls from giant incense spirals hanging from the ceiling, and flames in large brass urns devour paper offerings to the dead, such as the ubiquitous Hell banknotes. Built in 1847, the temple was dedicated to two deities, Man and Mo (gods of literature and war), both based on real people - the 3rd-century administrator Cheung Ah Tse and the 3rd-century soldier Kwan Yu - who were deified by the emperors. places.en: Touted as Hong Kong Island’s most dependable sight, the Star Ferry service was started in 1898 by Indian Parsi businessman Dorabjee Nowrojee Mithaiwala. Today, few activities in Hong Kong can compete with the excitement and romance of riding one of these iconic double-decker ferries as they chug ponderously between Kowloon and Hong Kong Island. They are by far the best and cheapest way to view the city skyline by day or night, with an air-conditioned cabin and open-air deck to enjoy. Some 70,000 passengers travel on Star Ferry’s small fleet every day.

places.uk: Храм присвячений даоському божеству Вонг Тай Сіню, що зцілює і виконує бажання. За легендою, у IV столітті пастух Вонг Чопін став даоським ченцем і досяг безсмертя. Комплекс збудований 1921 року за принципами [[e115|фен-шуй]]; п'ять стихій (метал, дерево, вода, вогонь, земля) втілені в архітектурі. Храм поєднує [[e116|даосизм]], [[e117|буддизм]] і [[e118|конфуціанство]]. Головна практика - гадання «кау чім»: трусять циліндр з паличками, доки одна не випаде, а тлумач пояснює номер.
places.en: The temple at Wong Tai Sin is one of Hong Kong’s largest, busiest, and most fascinating places of worship. The complex contains altars and shrines to Buddhist, Confucian, and Daoist deities, though it is primarily dedicated to the Daoist deity Wong Tai Sin, a 4th-century shepherd and later monk, reputed to have performed healing miracles. Accordingly, the temple is frequently visited by people hoping to cure or avoid illness. Beside the main temple you’ll find dozens of fortune-tellers, some of whom can reveal your fortune in English (albeit for a fee), mostly through palm and face reading.

Разом із Музеєм космосу і Культурним центром утворює культурний квартал. 2019 року відкрився після чотирирічної реконструкції з майже вдвічі більшою площею. Вхід на постійні виставки безкоштовний; найкраще в будні ближче до полудня.
places.en: Reopened in late 2019 after a lavish and lengthy renovation, the Hong Kong Museum of Art’s new facilities have doubled the number of galleries, including a new one on the roof, and increased the exhibition space to house monumental contemporary art. Two innovative restaurants have also been added: modern gourmet Australian restaurant Hue, and alfresco restaurant Ink, specializing in light snacks and seafood.

Статуя короля Георга VI (1958) і арка пам'яті китайців, загиблих у Першій світовій.
places.en: Opposite Hong Kong Park, just across Cotton Tree Drive, lie the expansive Zoological and Botanical Gardens, established in 1864. The gardens house dozens of animals such as lemurs, meerkats, sloths and monkeys, while its aviaries are filled with colorful birds from all over the world, including American flamingos and Bali mynahs. There are also hundreds of plants, including some ancient trees, which provide welcome shade in this quiet oasis. You’ll even find striking sculptures and fountains dotted around the gardens, as well as a children’s play area.

places.uk: Храм Конфуція поруч із храмом Лами - найбільший у Китаї поза Цюйфу, батьківщиною філософа в провінції Шаньдун. Провулок до храму прикрашає рідкісна для Пекіна декоративна арка пайлоу; уперше храм збудовано 1302 року за монгольської династії Юань.
places.en: Adjacent to the Lama Temple, the Confucius Temple is the largest in China outside Qufu, the philosopher’s birthplace in Shandong province. The alley leading to the temple has a fine pailou (decorative archway), few of which survive in Beijing. First built in 1302 during the Mongol Yuan dynasty, the temple served as the imperial college during the Yuan, Ming, and Qing dynasties. It was expanded in 1906 during the reign of Emperor Guangxu.

places.uk: Храм Фаюань, за кілька хвилин на схід від мечеті на Коров'ячій вулиці, заснований 696 року і, ймовірно, є найстарішим храмом Пекіна. Імператор Тан Тайцзун (правив 626-649) освятив його на пам'ять про воїнів, загиблих у поході проти північних племен.
places.en: A short walk east from Cow Street Mosque, the Fayuan Temple dates to 696 CE and is probably the oldest temple in Beijing. It was consecrated by the Tang Taizong emperor (r. 626-49) to commemorate the soldiers who perished in an expedition against the northern tribes. The original Tang-era buildings were destroyed by a succession of natural disasters, and the temple has been rebuilt several times over its 1,300-year history. The present structures date from the Ming (1368-1644) and Qing (1644-1912) eras.

places.en: The symbolic heart of Macau, the Largo do Senado or Senate Square has a number of stately colonial buildings set around it. Notable buildings include the Leal Senado, or Loyal Senate, which now houses Macau’s Municipal Affairs Bureau; the General Post Office; and the Santa Casa de Misericordia, an old refuge for orphans and the poor and destitute. There are also numerous shops, cafés, and restaurants in the area. The striking, wavy black-and-white tile patterns snaking across the square make it a great place to take photographs by day or night.

places.en: Small-scale but interesting exhibits make this museum worth a visit for insights into the maritime past upon which Macau’s wealth was built. Displays include models of Chinese junks, Portuguese ships and fishing boats, a mock Hakka village, a dragon boat, and a detailed scale model of old Macau. A highlight is the Little A-Ma Theatre, which tells the legend of a local goddess. There is also a nice bar located on the esplanade outside, which is open during museum hours.

places.uk: Національний музей Китаю площею понад 191 900 кв. м вважають найбільшим музеєм світу. Тут виняткова колекція давніх скарбів і реліквій: кераміка, бронза, нефрит, каліграфія; дві постійні експозиції присвячені давньому і новому Китаю.
places.en: Spread over more than 2 million sq ft (191,900 sq m), the National Museum of China is thought to be the largest museum in the world. places.uk: Храм Білої Хмари (Байюнь Гуань) - осідок Даоської асоціації Китаю, заснований 739 року; найбільша даоська святиня Пекіна. Його називали Храмом Небесної Вічності; це один із трьох родових храмів даоської школи Цюаньчжень, що наголошувала на праведних вчинках.
places.en: Home to the China Daoist Association, the White Cloud Temple (Baiyun Guan) was founded in 739 CE and is Beijing’s largest Daoist shrine. Known as the Temple of Heavenly Eternity, it was one of the three ancestral halls of the Quanzhen School of Daoism, which focused on right action and the benefits of good karma. Built largely of wood, the temple burned to the ground in 1166, and since then has been repeatedly destroyed and rebuilt. The structures that survive date largely from the Ming and Qing dynasties. places.uk: Мистецький район 798 у фабричному комплексі 1950-х: десятки галерей, дизайн-студій, ресторанів, кафе і крамниць сучасного мистецтва Пекіна. У вихідні тут повно молоді і митців, усе частіше - туристичних груп.
places.en: A hip development in a 1950s factory complex, the 798 Art District features dozens of galleries, design studios, restaurants, cafés, and shops, all showcasing Beijing’s thriving contemporary culture and art scene. It buzzes on weekends with a young, arty crowd, and increasingly with groups of out-of-town visitors. places.en: This extraordinary site contains the excavated gardens that surrounded the palace of Zhao Tuo, the founder of the ancient Nanyue Kingdom . A Qin general from Hebei province, he founded an independent kingdom after the fall of the Qin dynasty, and ruled over much of what is now northern Vietnam and parts of south China. The site is covered by a corrugated roof, and a raised pathway leads past the main sights. src.i: 6:30am-9pm daily; платно; 1 Wenjin Jie, Xicheng

places.uk: Парк Бейхай - імператорський сад понад 1000 років, відкритий для всіх 1925 року; його ще називають Зимовим палацом. Штучні пагорби, павільйони і храми; парк пов'язують з Хубілаєм, який перебудував його за династії Юань; поруч Кругле місто Туаньчен.
places.en: An imperial garden for more than 1,000 years, this park, also known as the Winter Palace, was opened to the public in 1925. Filled with artificial hills, pavilions, and temples, it is associated with Kublai Khan, who redesigned it during the Mongol Yuan dynasty. The Tuancheng (Round City) near the south entrance has a decorated jade urn that once belonged to him. The park is named after its lake, Bei Hai, the southern end of which is bordered by the inaccessible Zhong Nan Hai, the headquarters of the Communist Party. places.en: This museum is set inside the Ming-dynasty Xiannong temple complex. Starting in 1420, on the vernal equinox, the emperor would conduct sacrifices here, and then, dressed as a farmer, would plow furrows in a nearby field. The complex now houses Beijing’s first museum of architecture, covering Chinese building design from ancient to modern times.

East of the station is Victoria Park, Hong Kong’s largest park and a serene place to swim, play tennis, or practice your Tai Chi. Close to the Typhoon Shelter is the Noonday Gun, a blue 3-lb (1.5-kg) artillery gun that has been fired daily since the 1840s. places.en: The sleek, corporate cathedrals of banks and businesses tower over the ever-teeming streets of Hong Kong’s financial epicenter. There are relatively few cultural sights in Central, as many colonial buildings have long since disappeared, making way for high-rise development. The desire for real estate has always been strong, and land reclamation started almost as soon as the British took over in 1841. src.i: Daily; платно; метро Pingguo Yuan (1 hr), then bus M11, M22 to Zhaitang (2 hrs) or taxi; Near Zhaitang, 56 miles (90 km) NW of Beijing

places.uk: Дістатися Цуаньдіся непросто, але варто: напівзруйноване село - живий музей сільської архітектури Мін і Цін. На крутому схилі гори стоять гарні будинки з дворами (сихеюані).
places.en: Despite the rather laborious expedition required to get here, a trip to Cuandixia is well worth the effort; the crumbling hamlet survives as a living museum of Ming- and Qing-dynasty village architecture. Situated on a steep mountainside, it is a pretty outpost of courtyard houses (siheyuan) and rural Chinese buildings. Because of the close-knit nature of the original village, all the courtyards were interconnected by small lanes. Look out for the Maoist graffiti that survives on the boundary walls; similar graffiti from the Cultural Revolution has been whitewashed in most other towns.

src.i: 9am-5pm daily; 15 miles (25 km) E of Zhongshan

places.uk: Село Цуйхен на околиці Чжуншаня - батьківщина революціонера Сунь Ятсена (мандаринською Сунь Чжуншань), який народився тут 1866 року. Будинок у португальському стилі, який він збудував для родини, тепер музей.
places.en: The village of Cuiheng, located on the outskirts of Zhongshan, is the birthplace of revolutionary leader Sun Yat-sen, also known by his Mandarin name Sun Zhongshan. He was born here in 1866. The Portuguese-style house in which he lived with his parents between 1892 and 1895 is now part of Sun Yat-sen’s Residence , a museum complex devoted to his life, along with the Sun Yat-sen Memorial Hall next door, which has collected thousands of cultural artifacts and photographs. Nearby, other houses belonging to the same period have been restored and are also open to the public.

places.uk: Півострів Дапен на сході Шеньчженя - лісистий куточок, щоб утекти від сучасного центру. На піщаних пляжах Січун і Дунчун народжується серфінг, а стародавня фортеця Дапен нагадує про часи Мін.
places.en: Set on the eastern periphery of Shenzhen, this richly forested outcrop is a fabulous place to escape the city’s modern center. On the sandy beaches of Xichong and Dongchong a nascent surf scene is evolving, while Jiaochangwei Beach is the place for windsurfers. Nearby, Dapeng Fortress is a well-preserved Ming-dynasty garrison town offering a contrasting glimpse into Shenzhen’s ancient past.

places.uk: Парк Дітань - спокійне зелене місце з Храмом Землі, від якого парк отримав назву; тут відбувалися імператорські церемонії. Вівтар Фанцзе Тань з часів Мін; за Мін у місті було п'ять головних вівтарів за сторонами світу.
places.en: A peaceful and lush space, Di Tan is home to the Temple of Earth, which gives the park its name and was once the venue for imperial ceremonies. The park’s altar, Fangze Tan, dates back to the Ming dynasty. Under the Ming, five main altars were established at the city’s cardinal points - the Temple of Heaven in the south, Di Tan in the north, Ri Tan (Temple of the Sun) in the east, Yue Tan (Temple of the Moon) in the west, and Sheji Tan (Temple of Land and Grain) in the center of the city.

places.name: Eastern Qing Tombs

src.i: 8am-5pm daily; платно; метро Sihui; 77 miles (125 km) E of Beijing, Zunhua county, Hebei province

places.uk: Східні гробниці Цін далеко від міста, тому їх відвідують менше, ніж гробниці Мін, хоча місцевість ще мальовничіша. З багатьох гробниць лише п'ять належать імператорам Цін: Шуньчжі (1644-1661), Кансі (1661-1722) та іншим.
places.en: The remoteness of the Eastern Qing Tombs makes them far less popular than the Ming ones, despite the fact that the setting is even more splendid . Of the many tombs scattered throughout the area, only five are the burial places of Qing emperors: Shunzhi (r. 1644-61), Kangxi (r. 1661-1722), Qianlong (r. 1735-95), and Xianfeng (r. 1851-61) are open, while that of Tongzhi (r. 1862-74) is not. places.en: The busy industrial town of Qingyuan is the access point for two picturesque temples located at Feilai and Feixia on the Bei River. The temples can only be reached by boat (it’s best to charter one with a group). These depart early in the morning and return in the afternoon, passing fishers whose cormorants - trained to fish for them - sit patiently on the prows of their sampans. places.en: Foshan, meaning “Buddha Mountain,” was named after three ancient bronze Buddha statues found here in the 7th century. places.name: Great Bell Temple

src.i: 9am-4:30pm Tue-Sun; платно; метро Dazhong Si; 31a Beisanhuan Xi Lu, Haidian

places.uk: Храм Великого Дзвона (Дачжун Си) XVIII століття з чудовою колекцією дзвонів. Головний скарб - 46,5-тонний дзвін Юнле в задній вежі, відлитий у 1403-1424 роках і перевезений сюди з храму Ваньшоу за імператора Цяньлуна.
places.en: Home to a fantastic collection of bells, the 18th-century Dazhong Si (Great Bell Temple) follows a typical Buddhist layout. Its highlight is the 46.5-ton Yongle Bell in the rear tower. Cast between 1403 and 1424, it was brought here from Wanshou Temple during the reign of the Qianlong emperor. During the Ming and Qing dynasties, the bell was struck 108 times to bring in the New Year, and could be heard up to 25 miles (40 km) away. Visitors can pray for good luck by tossing a coin into the hole at the top of the bell.

places.en: Said to have been founded during the Western Han dynasty, Guangxiao Si (Temple of Glorious Filial Piety) is by far one of the city’s most attractive sights. Built over the palace of the last Nanyue king, Zhao Jiande, it became a temple in the 5th century and was later visited by Bodhidharma, the founder of Chan Buddhism. None of the original buildings survive, and most of the current halls date to the 19th century. src.i: 9am-6pm daily; Estrada de Cacilhas

places.en: The Guia Fort was built between 1622 and 1638 and offers great views over the town. Initially it served as a fort to defend the border with China, but in 1865 a lighthouse was added. A pleasant way to get here is to take the cable car to the hilltop. A small chapel stands next door and there are several gentle walking trails around the hill.

src.i: 10am-6pm Wed-Mon (to 8pm Fri & Sat); платно; 8 Museum Drive

places.uk: Гонконзький палацовий музей у золотавій асиметричній будівлі: понад 900 імператорських скарбів, позичених у Палацового музею Забороненого міста, багато вперше показані.
places.en: This asymmetric, gold-hued building houses over 900 imperial treasures on loan from Beijing’s Forbidden City Palace Museum, many never before seen outside the capital. Stylish galleries showcase China’s rich history, arts and culture, with items on display including Qing court robes and Song-dynasty ceramics, as well as rare calligraphy, bronzeware, and religious sculpture. Exhibits rotate regularly, and some galleries require timed tickets (see website for details).

places.en: On the same stretch of wall as Mutianyu, Huanghuacheng is a less-developed but exhilarating section. A pedal boat ride is the best way to explore these battlements.

places.uk: Імператорський сад на півночі за трьома внутрішніми палацами і Брамою Земного Спокою, з часів імператора Юнле династії Мін. Симетрично розташовані павільйони, храми і зали, сад каменів і давні дерева; по кутах - чотири павільйони сезонів.
places.en: The Imperial Garden, just north of the three inner palaces and the Gate of Earthly Tranquility, dates from the reign of the Ming Yongle emperor. It is symmetrically laid out with pavilions, temples, and halls as well as a rock garden and ancient trees. The pavilions at each of the four corners symbolize the seasons. The most famous of these are the charming Thousand Autumns Pavilion and Ten Thousand Springs Pavilion, each topped with a circular roof. On top of a lofty rockery in the northeast of the garden, the Imperial View Pavilion enjoys views over the gardens and beyond.

places.name: Jiankou

src.i: 24 hrs daily; платно; 56 miles (90 km) N of Beijing

places.uk: Цзянькоу - одна з найкрасивіших ділянок Великої стіни в Китаї, навколо колишнього села Січжацзи високо в північних горах Пекіна. Не відреставрована і офіційно закрита для туристів, але приваблює сміливих туристів-пішоходів і фотографів.
places.en: Offering some of the best Great Wall scenery in China, the Jiankou section wraps around the former commune village of Xizhazi high up in Beijing’s northern mountains. Unrestored and thus not officially open to tourists, it nonetheless attracts adventurous hikers and amateur photographers seeking that iconic sunrise photo. Many of the battlements here are in a crumbling state of disrepair and very steep as they trace the ridgeline of mountains up to 3,000 ft (1,000 m) high, so it’s advisable to go with a guide.

places.en: Situated on Beijing’s north-south axis, Jing Shan Park has its origins in the Yuan dynasty (1279-1368). Its hill was created from earth that was excavated while building the moat around the Forbidden City. In the early years of the Ming dynasty, it was known as Wansui Shan (Long Life Hill), but was renamed Jing Shan (View or Prospect Hill) in the Qing era. Foreign residents also referred to it as Mei Shan (Coal Hill), supposedly because coal was stored at the foot of the hill.

places.uk: Храм Лами (Юнхегун, Палац Миру і Гармонії) - один із найкрасивіших храмових комплексів Пекіна. Збудований наприкінці XVII століття як резиденція князя Юна, майбутнього імператора Юнчжена; пізніше тут жив імператор Цяньлун.
places.en: One of Beijing’s most beautiful temple complexes, the Lama Temple is also known as Yonghegong or the Palace of Peace and Harmony. Constructed in the late 17th century as a residence for Prince Yong, who went on to become Emperor Yongzheng, the temple was later occupied by Emperor Qianlong. In 1744, it was converted into a Tibetan lamasery.

src.i: 10am-6pm Tue-Sun (to 10pm Fri); платно; 38 Museum Drive

places.uk: M+ у будівлі у формі перевернутої літери T - перший великий музей сучасної візуальної культури Азії: дизайн, архітектура, кіно і мистецтво; на фасаді світлодіодний екран.
places.en: Housed in a huge, upturned T-shaped building, M+ is Asia’s first major museum of contemporary visual culture. Its ambitious, playful exhibitions focus on 20th- and 21st-century visual art, design, film, installation art, and architecture from Hong Kong, Asia, and beyond. Past shows have featured famous names like Yayoi Kusama, Nam June Paik, and Ai Weiwei. Other highlights include the rooftop garden with sweeping harbor views and the building’s LED facade; the latter acts as a massive screen on which commissioned artworks are displayed come nightfall.

places.en: Wedged between Hong Kong and the vast urban sprawl of Shenzhen, this globally important wetland managed by the World Wildlife Fund (WWF) is home to a huge range of wildlife species. Pollution has taken its toll elsewhere along the Pearl River delta, making this huge park the last refuge for many species. Thousands of migratory birds flock here to feed on crustaceans and small fish. Apart from the ubiquitous herons and egrets, otters and the endangered black-faced spoonbill - of which only some 2,000 are left in the world - can be seen here. places.en: Straddling the Yongding River in Wanping town, this 876-ft- (267-m-) long marble bridge was first built during the Jin dynasty in 1189 and has been restored and rebuilt several times since. Known as Lugou Qiao in Chinese, the bridge acquired its English name after the 13th-century explorer Marco Polo described it in his famous treatise The Travels . At the eastern and western ends are stelae inscribed by the Qing emperors Kangxi and Qianlong. places.en: Small-scale but interesting exhibits make this museum worth a visit for insights into the maritime past upon which Macau’s wealth was built. places.name: Mausoleum of the Nanyue King

src.i: 9am-5:30pm daily; платно; метро Yuexiu Park; 867 Jiefang Bei Lu

places.uk: Мавзолей царя Наньюе в серці Гуанчжоу біля парку Юесю: гробниця Чжао Мо, другого царя Наньюе, віком понад 2000 років. Генерала Цінь Чжао То послали сюди 214 року до н. е. підкорити південь; знахідки - нефритовий похоронний костюм.
places.en: In the heart of Guangzhou, next to Yuexiu Park, is the site of the 2,000-year-old tomb of Zhao Mo, the second king of Nanyue. Zhao Tuo, a Qin general from Hebei province, was sent here in 214 BCE to control southern China. After the fall of the Qin, Zhao Tuo established the Nanyue Kingdom. His grandson Zhao Mo succeeded him, reigning from 137-122 BCE. The kingdom was reclaimed by the Han kings in 111 BCE, following the hasty succession of three further Nanyue rulers. The tomb contains several magnificent burial items made of gold and precious stones, including a jade burial suit.

places.en: With individual galleries spread across five floors of a starkly Modernist building, this well-run museum features works that run the gamut from colonial-era oil paintings to contemporary Chinese photography. There is also an excellent collection of antique ceramics and other archaeological finds, plus classical Chinese calligraphy. The museum has an ever-changing roster of temporary exhibitions, often featuring work by well-known contemporary international and Chinese artists.

places.uk: Мутяньюй приваблює драматичним гірським краєвидом і меншою туристичною метушнею, ніж Бадалін. Стіна тут з 1368 року і йде шляхом давнішого укріплення династії Північна Ці (550-577).
places.en: The appeal of Mutianyu lies in its dramatic hilly setting and slightly less intrusive tourist industry than at Badaling. The wall here dates from 1368 and follows the same route as an earlier fortification erected during the Northern Qi dynasty (550-77 CE). Records indicate that Mutianyu served as signal towers, forts, living quarters, and storerooms.

places.en: Housed in an enormous 1950s building, this museum is the largest of its type in China, with about 5,000 specimens arranged into three main collections: paleontology, zoology, and botany. src.i: The “street of happiness” once teemed with brothels, hence its bestowed name. It’s now a thoroughfare full of cheap restaurants.

places.uk: Руа-да-Фелісідаде («Вулиця щастя»): тут пахне солодощами - печуть і продають барвисте маканезьке печиво і тістечка. Колись вулиця була кварталом розваг; червоні віконниці збереглися.
places.en: A variety of sweet scents waft from the Rua da Felicidade, or “Street of Happiness,” where tasty and colorful Macanese biscuits and cakes are baked and sold. The area was once packed with brothels, hence its somewhat ironically bestowed name. Today, it is a charming, cobbled street lined with small eateries, teahouses, and souvenir shops.

places.en: Leased to the French and British after the Chinese were defeated during the Second Opium War (1856-60), this island is really little more than a sandbank about half a mile (800 m) long. Before being allowed to settle on Shamian Island, foreigners had been compelled to remain in their warehouses on the mainland. Soon after the French settled at the east end and the British at the west, the streets filled with European-style villas, banks, and churches. places.en: Shaoguan town has only a handful of sights, such as the Fengcai Lou, a reconstruction of an ancient city gate, and the Dajian Chan Monastery founded in 660 CE, but there are three worthwhile places of interest near the town. The Nanhua Si (Southern China Temple), 16 miles (25 km) to the southeast, was founded in 502 CE and became renowned for its connection with Bodhidharma, the founder of Chan (Zen) Buddhism who meditated here for 36 years. One of the halls contains a statue of him, said to have been cast from his corpse; another has a statue of a monk walking on stilts made of lotus flowers.

places.name: Southeast Corner Watchtower

src.i: платно; метро Beijing Railway Station; Off Jianguo Men Nan Dajie, Chongwen

places.uk: Неподалік на південь від Стародавньої обсерваторії вцілів величний шмат міських мурів - Південно-східна кутова вежа XV століття (Дунбянь Мень). Можна піднятися на зубчасті мури Мін і пройти коротким, але вражаючим відрізком.
places.en: A short distance south of the Ancient Observatory, an imposing chunk of the Beijing city walls survives in the form of the 15th-century Southeast Corner Watchtower (Dongbian Men). After climbing onto the Ming-dynasty battlements, visitors can walk along the short but nonetheless impressive stretch of attached wall to admire the towering bastion, pitted with archers’ windows, and look down on the city below. The walls of the tower are engraved with graffiti left by soldiers of the international army that marched into the city to liberate the Foreign Legations during the Boxer Rebellion.

places.en: The Tsim Sha Tsui promenade features some of the ritziest arcades, museums, and hotels in the city, as well as the famous Star Ferry pier. East of the pier is the iconic Hong Kong Cultural Centre, which houses a concert hall and theater. places.en: Immortalized in Richard Mason’s 1957 novel The World of Suzy Wong , Wan Chai’s colorful red light district has now largely given way to fancy bars, restaurants, and hotels. The Wan Chai Metro Rail Transit (MTR) station is a good starting point for a walking tour. A trip down Lockhart Road, just around the corner, reveals the area’s few remaining ties with its past in the form of a handful of hostess bars.

places.en: Instantly recognizable by its distinctive 167-ft (51-m) white Tibetan-style dagoba (stupa or funerary mound) designed by a Nepalese architect, the White Tower Temple (Miaoying Si) dates to 1271, when Beijing was under Mongol rule. In addition to its conventional Drum and Bell Towers, Hall of Heavenly Kings, and Main Halls, this Buddhist temple has a remarkable collection of small Tibetan Buddhist statues and a collection of 18 bronze luohan (disciples).

places.en: The central mountainous region is worth a visit for its spectacular landscape and to explore the island’s Indigenous Li culture. Wuzhi Shan City (also known as Tongshi) is the capital of the autonomous Li and Miao governments. src.i: 6am-6:30pm daily; платно; метро Xiangshan; Wofosi Lu, Xiang Shan, Haidian

places.uk: Парк Сяншань (Ароматні пагорби) найкрасивіший восени, коли червоніють клени. Головне - краєвиди з піку Курильниці (є крісельна канатна дорога) і храм Бі'юнь (Лазурової Хмари) біля головної брами.
places.en: This wooded area, also known as Fragrant Hills Park, is at its scenic best in the fall, when the maples turn red. Its main draws are the fine views from Incense Burner Peak, accessible by a chairlift, and Biyun Temple, or Azure Cloud Temple, near the main gate. The temple is guarded by the menacing deities Heng and Ha in the Mountain Gate Hall. A series of halls leads to the Sun Yat-sen Memorial Hall, named for the founder of the Republic of China, whose coffin was temporarily stored here in 1925. At the temple’s rear is the Diamond Throne Pagoda.

places.en: Covered by woven metal panels designed to look like silk curtains, the Xiqu Centre is the cutting-edge home for the long-standing art form of Cantonese opera. Inside, there’s a soaring atrium, as well as two theaters: the Grand Theatre, which stages full-length performances (often with English subtitles), and the smaller Tea House Theatre, offering narrated 90-minute shows with tea and dim sum, perfect for those enjoying Cantonese opera for the first time. Book tickets for performances via the WestK website or at the Xiqu box office.

places.en: This attractive city was the home of the Italian Jesuit priest Matteo Ricci in the late 16th century, until he was expelled by a local official in 1589. Today Zhaoqing is famous for the rugged scenery at Qixing Yan (Seven Star Crag), whose misty lakeside peaks lie in the shape of the Big Bear constellation - once thought of as fallen stars. Situated a mile (1.5 km) north of the Xi River, its many shady islets, craggy hills, and illuminated caves can be explored via a vast network of bridges and causeways.

places.name: Lamma Island
places.uk: Острів без машин з пішохідною стежкою між селищами і рибними ресторанами.
places.en: Great seafood and pubs, a relaxed atmosphere, pleasant hilltop walks, and the absence of cars make leafy Lamma the perfect escape from the city bustle. Its two main villages, Yung Shue Wan on the west coast and restaurant-packed Sok Kwu Wan on the east coast, are a half-hour ferry ride from Central. A steep climb leads to the hills above Yung Shue Wan, where you can enjoy wonderful views of the sea and Hong Kong Island. You can hike between the two villages, but plan your walk around the infrequent ferries. The harbor at Sok Kwu Wan is home to Lamma Fisherfolk’s Village, a floating exhibition

гуанчжоу тисячолітній порт морського шовкового шляху. з 1757 по 1842 рік - єдиний порт китаю для західної торгівлі (система кантону, тринадцять факторій). конфлікт навколо опіуму привів до опіумних війн; острів шамянь був британською і французькою концесією.

гонконг острів передано британії 1842 року за нанкінським договором, коулун 1860, нові території взято в оренду 1898 року на 99 років. 1997 року гонконг повернувся китаю за принципом «одна країна, дві системи»: своя валюта, свої закони, лівосторонній рух.

макао португальці оселилися тут з 1557 року; це перша і остання європейська колонія в китаї, повернута 20 грудня 1999 року. звідси маканезька кухня і мова патуа, португальська бруківка і азулежу поруч з китайськими храмами.
шеньчжень 1980 року невеликі містечка біля кордону стали першою спеціальною економічною зоною. за кілька десятиліть тут виріс мегаполіс з понад 17 млн мешканців і світовий центр електроніки.
чай коли вам наливають чай, легко постукайте двома пальцями по столу - це «дякую». порожній чайник у ресторані дім-саму залиште з відкритою кришкою: його доллють.
палички не встромляйте палички вертикально в рис (так роблять на похоронах) і не стукайте ними по мисці. беріть їжу зі спільних страв, а не ковиряйтесь у них.
числа 8 - щасливе (звучить як «багатство»), 4 - нещасливе (звучить як «смерть»): у будинках часто немає 4, 14, 24 поверхів.
подарунки не даруйте годинник, ножі, ножиці, білі квіти і нічого по 4 штуки. подарунки і візитки передають двома руками.
храми пахощі купують і запалюють за звичаєм храму; не фотографуйте людей, що моляться, зблизька; у залах будди часто не можна фотографувати. плечі краще прикрити.

свята на ваших датах свято чунъян 2026 уже минуло (18.10). у гонконгу 31.10 гучний хелловін (lan kwai fong, ocean park). у гуанчжоу з 31.10 третій етап кантонської ярмарки (known_unverified): людно в метро і готелях.
оплата у материковому китаї майже все через alipay і wechat pay; іноземні картки працюють у застосунках. у гонконгу - картка octopus, у макао - готівка mop або hkd, картки і alipay.
чайові у материковому китаї чайових не дають. у гонконгу ресторани додають 10% сервісного збору; дрібні гроші таксисту - за бажанням.
туалети беріть із собою серветки і антисептик: у багатьох туалетах немає паперу, трапляються «азійські» туалети навпочіпки.
вода у материковому китаї воду з-під крана не пийте, лише бутильовану або кип'ячену; у готелях є чайник. у гонконгу вода з крана безпечна за стандартами, але місцеві теж кип'ятять.
мова у гонконгу, макао і гуанчжоу говорять кантонською, але мандаринську розуміють; у гонконгу і макао традиційні ієрогліфи, у материку спрощені. англійська в гонконгу поширена, у материку - мало.
поведінка в метро у mtr гонконгу і метро материка не можна їсти й пити (у гонконгу штраф). ставайте праворуч на ескалаторі, якщо так стоять місцеві.
документи у материковому китаї паспорт має бути з собою завжди: його питають на вокзалах, у музеях і готелях; копії не приймають (dk china 2026).
ранковий китай зранку в парках тайцзи, ушу, співи і гра в маджонг; увечері на площах «танці на площі» (广场舞). це відкрито для спостереження і участі.
ринки мокрі ринки з живою рибою і птицею - звична частина побуту; фото продавців без дозволу не робіть.
торг на ринках і в хуацянбей торгуються, у магазинах з цінниками - ні. починайте з половини названої ціни на ринку.
здуття і гази симетикон (西甲硅油); у гонконгу антацидні засоби з симетиконом 我肚子胀，有很多气。
печія і кислота антациди: гідроталькіт (铝碳酸镁, бренд 达喜), gaviscon (嘉胃斯康 у гонконгу); фамотидин (法莫替丁) 我胃灼热，反酸。
пронос смектит (蒙脱石散, бренд 思密达); лоперамід (洛哌丁胺, бренд 易蒙停); регідрон (口服补液盐iii); пробіотики (益生菌) 我拉肚子。
харчове отруєння і зневоднення регідратація: 口服补液盐iii або електроліти (电解质水); пити часто малими ковтками 我可能食物中毒了，又吐又拉。
закреп лактулоза (乳果糖); гліцеринові свічки або 开塞露 我便秘。
нудота і заколисування дименгідринат (茶苯海明); імбирні цукерки (姜糖) 我恶心，晕车。
нетравлення від важкої їжі ферменти (多酶片); традиційні 保济丸 (po chai, класика гонконгу), 健胃消食片 我消化不良，吃太油了。
застуда, горло, кашель льодяники для горла (润喉糖), сироп 念慈菴枇杷膏 (гонконг); засоби без кодеїну 我嗓子疼，咳嗽。
біль і температура парацетамол (对乙酰氨基酚; panadol 必理通 у гонконгу); ібупрофен (布洛芬) 我头疼，发烧。
алергія лоратадин (氯雷他定), цетиризин (西替利嗪) 我过敏了。
укуси комах репелент (驱蚊液), засіб від свербежу (止痒膏) 我被蚊子咬了，很痒。
мозолі, порізи пластирі (创可贴), антисептик (碘伏), пластирі для мозолів (水泡贴) 我脚磨破了。
